question: A team from the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) in Ahmedabad identified an exoplanet in 2021 that is _________ times the size of Jupiter.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.4.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Researchers at the **Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) in Ahmedabad** **have found an exoplanet that is located 725 light years away**.
 
• It is **1.4 times the size of Jupiter**.
 
• Its orbital period is 3.2 Earth days, which is abnormally near to a star.
 
• It is incredibly hot, with surface temperatures as high as 2,000 degrees Kelvin (1726.85 degrees Celsius) and an expanded radius with very low density due to its close closeness to its star.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Physical Research Laboratory (PRL):**

 
• **Dr. Vikram A. Sarabhai** **established** the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL)** in 1947**. The lab's modest beginnings involved studying cosmic rays at his home, the RETREAT.
 
• The M. G. Science College in Ahmedabad hosted the Laboratory's** formal inauguration on November 11, 1947**, with assistance from the Ahmedabad Education Society and the Karmkshetra Educational Foundation.
 
• Research on cosmic rays and the characteristics of the upper atmosphere was the primary focus at first.
 
• Subsequent research in radio physics and theoretical physics was added with funding from the Atomic Energy Commission.
